listening.title: Planning the last week before the tax finalization deadline

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Nam, the submission deadline is next Monday. Where are we now?

lines.speaker: Nam (Accountant)
lines.text: Most of the work is done. I have ticked every checklist item except one.

lines.speaker: Nam (Accountant)
lines.text: The depreciation report for the factory. The site manager has not replied yet.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: I will call him this afternoon. When can you give me the final figures?

lines.speaker: Nam (Accountant)
lines.text: Tomorrow evening, if the factory data arrives before lunch.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: That is a tight schedule, but it should work.

lines.speaker: Nam (Accountant)
lines.text: Should I plan an overtime shift on Saturday, just in case?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Yes, please. March is always our workload peak, and I do not want surprises.

lines.speaker: Nam (Accountant)
lines.text: Understood. What happens if we cannot file on time?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: The company pays a late penalty, and nobody in the board likes that.

lines.speaker: Nam (Accountant)
lines.text: Then it is crunch time. I will answer your emails within the hour.
